product.title: Kohala Waterfalls & Valleys Helicopter Tour

description.text: From the Kona side of the Big Island, the soaring sea cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and rainforest-clad headlands of the Kohala Coast are even more impressive when viewed from above. Admire the scenery as you fly overhead in a luxury helicopter, swoop over the Kohala Mountains, spot ancient Hawaiian settlements from the air, and enjoy magnificent ocean views. Stops include Kohala Coast, Kohala Mountains, Kohala Waterfalls, Waikoloa Heliport. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kona's coastline, volcanic highlands, coffee country, and island landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
